matched_heldout_comparisons.design: identical world snapshot, identical exposure, identical allowed actor-info packets across arms; ONLY the arm machinery differs; matched model/version/temperature/max_tokens/seed; blind counterbalanced presentation

cases.question: same world, different admitted developmental histories
same nodes, different admitted temporal relational topology

matched_heldout_comparisons.heldout_lock: expected_typed_codes are the ONLY scoring truth; they are frozen here and must not be edited after any behavioral capture

pretyped_blind_scoring.principle: scoring is on TYPED ACTION CODES, never prose/surface/style

elicitation.primary: typed response menu offered to the model; model selects exactly one code per trial; menu order counterbalanced
elicitation.secondary_validation: free-text response arm; coded to typed codes by a scorer that never sees arm labels or expected codes; disagreement with menu arm reported as ELICITATION_DIVERGENCE

pretyped_blind_scoring.prose_policy: prose captured for audit only; any scoring that reads prose is INVALID; prose never scored
pretyped_blind_scoring.scoring_correctness: fraction of paired seeds whose selected code matches the frozen expected_typed_codes entry; per K per arm per comparator

counterbalance.presentation_code_assignment: deterministic permutation of arm labels per block; scorer sees only counterbalance_code
counterbalance.block_design: each K x contrast x seed block presents all arms; order rotated

firewalls.accessible_trace_firewall: K3 actor-visible packet MUST NOT contain hidden origin content; only NON_DISCLOSABLE_ORIGIN markers; hidden-origin injection into evaluator-only metadata must leave actor-safe payload byte-identical
firewalls.objective_standing_separation: K5 objective_public_standing_effects change only via admitted ratification owner effect; actor belief state never auto-changes from witness power; belief recorded as testimony, never adjudicated as truth
firewalls.no_extra_latent_psychology_owners: no new durable psychology store may be introduced by any comparator arm; B_admissible is display-only; C_admissible is cache-only
firewalls.event_custody: every packet element references admitted events only; unadmitted draft/rejected event = trial INVALID with typed hold code

matched_budgets.budget_falsifier: if any arm's median completion tokens differs by >25% under identical max_tokens, report BUDGET_ASYMMETRY and treat cross-arm comparison as qualified

experimental_nulls_ex_ante.null: paraphrased world/history text (semantically identical) must not change typed code distribution
shuffled actor/place names must not change typed codes
counterbalanced menu order must not change typed code distribution (position bias)
prose style variation in the packet must not change typed codes
hidden-origin content in evaluator metadata never appears in actor-visible output
scorer fed only typed codes reproduces scorer fed full receipts
halved max_tokens must not change typed codes

effect_uncertainty_plan.unit: paired seeds within K x contrast x arm
effect_uncertainty_plan.primary_statistic: typed correctness fraction per arm per K
effect_uncertainty_plan.paired_comparison: B_admissible minus A and C_admissible minus A on typed correctness
effect_uncertainty_plan.equivalence_margin: ±5 percentage points; without prospective power the result is INDETERMINATE, never EQUIVALENT (LAB1 discipline preserved)
effect_uncertainty_plan.promotion_screening_threshold: +10 percentage points with paired interval excluding zero
effect_uncertainty_plan.no_population_claim: any behavioral result is a claim about the named pinned model under this protocol ONLY; never a human/population calibration
